notes: A public-API translation of the native-green 73-assertion HLA_EVOKED saved-live-directed-TSO case. A constrained receiver has a timestamp-six directed interaction queued when two members complete an untimed save. The publisher then retracts the saved designator and observes its terminal state. Restore rolls back that post-save terminal ledger. Flush Queue Request delivers the saved target-qualified interaction and same public designator before its grant. Retraction becomes legal again, invokes Request Retraction, and terminalizes a second time. This differs from the multi-recipient directed case, which retracts a different post-save handle. Isolated C++ primary/contract passed using only installed 2026-10-20 package libraries with integer64 and float64 time. The adapter supplies provider libraries, endpoint, IEEE 1516.2-2025 directed object/interaction FOM, logical-time implementation, and HLA_EVOKED callback model. Java parity compiles against the official API-only JAR; Java provider runtime, HLA_IMMEDIATE, durable/process-boundary restore, interoperability, and conformance are unverified.
